name: hxwerks
description: Leadwerks 5 Haxe/Lua bindings and entity-script tooling — full API coverage (Entity, World, Camera, GUI, Collider, Joint, Steamworks, PhysX, VR, UI widgets, and more).
releasenote: Added Scene, Brush, Face, Buffer, BufferStream, AssetBrowser, PropertyGrid, Terrain, ParticleEmitter, Pixmap, AudioFilter, Package, Mesh, Event, Timer, Component, Sprite, Tile, TextureBuffer, Decal, Probe, Client, Server, MeshLayer; World stats (RenderStats/PhysicsStats/AnimationStats) typed; IVec2/3/4, Vec2/3/4 operator overloads (+,-,*,/,-); missing methods (GetComponent, World.Save, Material.SetBlend, Collider.Save, Terrain.AddMeshLayer, GetEntities/GetEntitiesInArea returns Array<Entity>); all missing Globals factories and constants (BLEND_*, SAVE_*, MESSAGE_*, VIEWMODE_*, CUBEMAP_*, 20+ EVENT_*). All externs use @:native('_G') pattern, no constructors, no untyped __lua__ for method calls.
